description: As Team YILDIZ, we make hard-to-learn topics enjoyable and immersive by taking them and gamifying them. Each of our members is skilled in their field: İsmail Esad in game development and publishing, Celil in idea development and AI, lecturer Göksel in commercialization and digital marketing. Together, we’ve built a strong team. We’re prepared for the NASA Space Apps Challenge and we’re ready to compete!
